expectations.text: Includes breach/incident notification clauses with concrete timing supporting the customer's regulatory clocks (e.g., 24-72h vendor notification; GDPR 72h; DORA incident reporting support)
expectations.evidence: "no later than [24 hours]... set to support your own DORA major-ICT-incident reporting clock and any overlapping GDPR 72-hour controller obligation"

expectations.text: Includes assurance rights: annual SOC 2 Type II or ISO 27001 evidence delivery, right to review exceptions, plus audit/access rights
expectations.evidence: "Annual SOC 2 Type II report (or ISO 27001 certificate + current Statement of Applicability)... right to review any exceptions" plus clause 3 full audit and access rights

expectations.text: Includes sub-processor provisions: current list, advance change notice, objection right, equivalent flow-down
expectations.evidence: "Current list of sub-contractors... minimum [30]-day advance notice of changes, an objection right, and... obligations flow down identically"

expectations.text: Addresses DORA specifically for critical/important functions: Art. 30(3) enhanced provisions such as full audit and access rights (including for regulators), exit strategies/termination assistance, and notes the Register of Information (Art. 28(3)) entry
expectations.evidence: "Full audit and access rights (DORA Art. 30(3))" for entity, third party "and its competent authority"; "Exit strategy and termination assistance... (Art. 28(8))"; "Register of Information for this arrangement (Art. 28(3))"

expectations.text: Includes data lifecycle clauses: locations, encryption, no secondary use (e.g., no model training without consent), and return plus certified deletion with backup-expiry timeline
expectations.evidence: "locations (countries/regions) where data will be processed"; "Encryption standards in transit/at rest; no use of customer data for the vendor's own model training"; "certified deletion (including backup-cycle expiry date)"
